fact: Project Workflow describes the ordered project stages and their transitions.
A Stage is a unit of work in the Project Workflow with a defined result and condition for advancing.
The Main Session is the Pi conversation in which the user starts and monitors a Taskbook run.
A Subagent is a named task participant with its own session and assigned responsibility.
Design is the stage that produces the approved implementation taskbook.
Designer is the subagent assigned to produce and assess design proposals.
A Designer Group consists of a lead Designer and two member Designers.
Lead Designer owns the version of the design taskbook sent to Implementer and coordinates resolution of Review findings.
Member Designer contributes an independent design and reviews approved plans or implementation within the Designer Group.
Implementer is the subagent responsible for modifying the project and returning a candidate commit.
Review is the stage that checks a candidate and its draft facts against the taskbook, project conventions, and implementation evidence.
A Playbook gives an agent the prompts and decision rules for its work states.
A Work State is a step in a single agent's playbook and determines which prompt it receives next.
A Work Turn is one invocation of a named Subagent in a specified Work State on versioned inputs.
A Round collects the results of a defined set of Work Turns before releasing their results to the next set.
Consult is a Work State in which the current agent classifies a question and resolves it or routes it to its owner.
A Fact is an atomic statement with a source and an applicability scope in the project facts.
A Taskbook Fact is a fact supplied by the taskbook or its fact attachment and identified by that taskbook's tag.
A Draft Fact is a statement proposed by a Designer or Implementer for later Review and Fact Management.
Fact Management is the stage that reconciles an input list with project facts and commits the resulting changes.
Handoff is the stage that prepares the delivery record and publishes authorized pull request updates.
